review:
Big Bass with two different bonuses. Up to five scatters give as many as 20 free spins, and it starts with a card pick: two of the 12 cards unlock the Golden Lake round instead of the classic one.

In Golden Lake, the fisherman can hook gold diamonds that rewind the reels for more prizes – bigger potential than the standard mode. Both versions have a meter for extra spins and higher multipliers, plus the usual retrigger every four fishermen. 96.07% RTP.
